mapper.select: select * from users where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and lower(email) = lower(#{email}) limit 1
select * from users where lower(email) = lower(#{email}) limit 1

select distinct u.* from users u left join user_roles ur on ur.user_id = u.id left join roles r on r.id = ur.role_id where u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ( #{keyword} = '' or lower(u.email) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(u.display_name) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(r.name) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') ) order by u.created_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(1) from users where tenant_id = #{tenantId}

select count(distinct u.id) from users u left join user_roles ur on ur.user_id = u.id left join roles r on r.id = ur.role_id where u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ( #{keyword} = '' or lower(u.email) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(u.display_name) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(r.name) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') )
